source: Uses the existing JPartDataBi4/JBinaryData native array API. It does not parse BI4 bytes independently,load a solver class or invoke a compiler/solver/process. Root-owned wrapper must bind program/source/runtime hashes and actual owned exit before accepting its offline result.

CLI.read: --read DATA_DIR SOIL FIXED SAMPLES DT CADENCE MODEL NEWREVIEWDIR, argc10;DATA_DIR is canonical joboutput/data containing Part_NNNN.bi4. MODEL=-1OFF,0constant,1smooth.
CLI.half: --half LEFT_PHYSICAL_BIN RIGHT_PHYSICAL_BIN NEWJSON,argc5. Caller must bind the same model/coarse-half pair; comparator independently checks identical initial26fields/IDs and exact common clocks. No option difference is treated as a half.

scope: Prepared public nine-input matrix only:2D512soil/0fixed periodic or1024soil/256real fixed parallelFreeSlip slab. Weak amplitude2^-9,zero gravity,freshJ1,original scalarfloatk0=.0001,initialp/p0/stress0,constant dyadic dt. No new theory solver,reference tuning,general walls,gravity,GPU or exact restart claim.

native_contract.frames: ExactlySAMPLES one-piece PART files,all existing contiguous IDs,counts and no exclusions. Actual time=part*CADENCE;Step0 initially otherwisecompletedsteps-1;SymplecticDtPre exactDT;emitted dterror finite and signed<=1e-14 perframe;raw signed telemetry andmin/max retained,not an absoluteclockresidual.

SigmaState_ij order isxy,yz,xz;reader maps it correctly into private rowxy,xz,yz.
native_contract.ON: Strict4native model scalar types/values:boolmastertrue,uintschema1,uintmodel0/1,doubleCk0/2^-13. Six actualdoubleJ/n/theta/currentV/mixturerho/currentk arrays plus realfloatPosDiv required. No mask,manufactured PosDiv or fabricated J.
native_contract.OFF: Allsix dynamic arrays,PosDiv andfour ON-only model scalars absent. Only original15/raw identity/history are emitted byreader;nofake26fileornewJledger/energy claim.
native_contract.initial: Allsoil actualcell-centered coordinates and floatvx=A*sin(2pi*x/.125),vy/vz0,p0/stress0 verified. ON J1,n0=.25,theta0. Fixed coordinate/physicalvelocity byte-unchanged for fullhistory.
native_contract.derived: For every soil/allframes J>1-n0,absJ-1<=1e-4,nin(0,1),V=Dp²J,rho=1000+(2048-1000)/J,k=double(float.0001)orpositiveexponentiallaw. Each savedderived quantity relativeledgererror<=5e-13;solidvolumeidentityabs<=5e-13. Fixedn,V,rho,k,theta are0markers;fixedJ isnotrequired1 becauseitmaybehydraulicmirrorstate.

Actual completeforce/gradient timestepguard remains a production/runtime prerequisite;native reader does not claim unrecorded Ace/cache/stage verification.
native_contract.energy: Nativeweak-field energy fromfullXYZvelocity,doubleeffective stress,pressure,savedcurrentV/rho/n. AllONframes ratio<=1.1;initialenergy>0. OFFhistory uses0asnot-evaluated marker andcomplete.new_model_energy_evaluated=false.
native_contract.nonempty: Onlyfull257frameONruns requiremax|J-1|>1e-8;fullmodel1 also maximum sameframe spatialkspan/k0 and maximum |k/k0-1| each>=.005. Debug2step isnotgivenfullwindow nonemptygate.

outputs.identity: native_ids/fixed_ids useoriginalwallcontrolCSVformat;periodic wall_band0 andfixedCSVheaderonly. Modelnotwritten intohistory soabsent/explicitOFF deterministic historiescanbecomparedbyteexact.
